title.narrative: HPN - Afya UGAVI: Procurement and Supply Management Technical Assistance

description.narrative: (Kenya): Using FY 2023 funds, USAID/Kenya and East Africa (KEA) will fund the Afya Ugavi activity, the goal of which is to strengthen supply chain systems to improve both patient-level services and commodity security. The activity will prioritize interventions which further the primary health care objectives to maximize the impact of USAID investments, address data visibility and use, address health workforce capacity constraints, and support the delivery of improved whole person care that is more optimally integrated and coordinated. .Through an integrated approach, Afya Ugavi will focus on strengthening supply chain management systems at the national level and in 29 priority counties for the delivery and improved availability of quality health products and technologies. The activity will achieve these goals by strengthening the systems for commodity security and patient-centered pharmaceutical services, governance, and supply chain risk mitigation capacity. More specifically, this support will strengthen capacity for quantification, commodity logistics, and pharmaceutical services management; improve Ministry of health stewardship and oversight, stakeholder coordination, advocacy, and evidence generation for improved supply chain resource allocation; and strengthen monitoring and supervision systems, availability, and the use of logistics information for decision-making...Ultimately, the Afya Ugavi activity's mandate of strengthening health supply chains and pharmaceutical management systems are cornerstones for achieving USAID's global health efforts focused to end preventable child and maternal deaths; control the HIV/AIDS epidemic; control and eliminate malaria; combat infectious diseases; increase and sustain access to safe, voluntary, high-quality family planning and reproductive health services; and sustainably strengthen the health system. ..
